full_details: You were up before the alewife. Amersham at six, Wendover at nine under the scarp, Aylesbury by noon. A pedlar sold you a ballad-sheet for a penny, for a girl who cannot read it. Along the headlands the wheat was thin and light-eared, and the barley stood to a man's knee. At twenty past three, between Aylesbury and Waddesdon, you spoke the boy under the wall and spoke no finished line of it. You said the horse was dear, and that it was not why. Grendon at dusk, an alehouse with no sign. The constable examined you under a horn lantern, disliked the knot, and let you lie there if you did not gather. You bit your lip until your eyes watered, and you did not mend his news. On the tables you put six of his words, and the four you were afraid of losing.
one_sentence: You carried a boy under a wall as far as Grendon, and a constable allowed you one bench.
title: Took one bench at Grendon
